calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as customer_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL
  AND store_key IN (
    SELECT store_key FROM dim_store 
    WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as customer_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL
  AND store_key IN (
    SELECT store_key FROM dim_store 
    WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900
  )
  AND sale_date >= '2024-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as count_with_tampere_home
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE
  AND m.home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900)

SELECT MIN(sale_date) as first_sale, MAX(sale_date) as last_sale
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key IN (
  SELECT store_key FROM dim_store 
  WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900
)

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as member_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as non_member_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key IN (
  SELECT store_key FROM dim_store 
  WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900
)

-- Verify the store_key mapping is consistent
SELECT ds.store_id, ds.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.member_key) as customers
FROM dim_store ds
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON ds.store_key = fsl.store_key AND fsl.member_key IS NOT NULL
WHERE ds.city = 'Tampere' AND ds.is_current = TRUE AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
ORDER BY ds.store_id
